text:
Mushroom Cheese Quiche 
2 pie crust
2 cans of mushrooms (or box and can)
2 LG onions
1 1/2 tbsp flour (can put up to 1/3 cup flour)
~1 tsp salt
1/4 tsp white pepper 
1/2 tsp baking powder 
6 oz muster cheese (can mix mozzarella)
2 eggs
2/3 cup milk

This is what you should use for the ingredients but I'm going to send you a picture which is a handwritten recipe which has a lot of other quantities but you should not use those only use that for the instructions for what to do not for the ingredients
